description: Read recent large ERC-20 transfers directly from Base, Ethereum, or Arbitrum by scanning Transfer logs over the most recent blocks and filtering by a minimum token amount. Defaults to USDC on Base. Public RPC providers cap the scan window, so this covers the most recent blocks rather than a long history, and it does not label exchange wallets. GET accepts scalar query parameters. For object or array inputs, pass the complete input object as JSON in the payload query parameter. Price: 0.005 USDC. Mode: live_source. Source: public EVM JSON-RPC ERC-20 Transfer logs. Set auto_pay=true for a one-call purchase when the local buyer wallet is configured.

auto_pay.description: Automatically authorize and pay this request with the locally configured buyer wallet. Requires X402_AUTO_PAY=true and X402_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.

payment_id.description: payment_id returned by the x402 invoice.

payment_signature.description: Base64 x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE produced by a compatible buyer client.

preview.description: Inspect a rate-limited live contract proof showing source, freshness, response shape, and required inputs. Decision-ready values remain in the paid result.

tx_hash.description: Base transaction hash after paying an x402 invoice.

name: get_whale_alerts
